page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Optimized3.Flex.1-8 is an entry-tier virtual machine instance within the Optimized compute family. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance operates on a dedicated Intel Xeon 6354 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.0 GHz. The configuration allocates 1 physical core presenting 2 virtual CPUs via multithreading, coupled with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per thread.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring attached network volumes for root filesystem execution and persistent data storage. It contains no GPU hardware acceleration components. For external connectivity, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure provisions one complimentary public IPv4 address. Because it utilizes dedicated physical core scheduling rather than a burstable or shared-core allocation model, the instance provides deterministic CPU performance, optimizing cost efficiency for workloads that require predictable execution times without the overhead of unused compute capacity.

VM.Optimized3.Flex.1-8 is suited for lightweight production environments, small-scale microservices, CI/CD build agents, general-purpose web serving, and backend application middleware. The 3.0 GHz Intel Xeon processor supports latency-sensitive tasks that benefit from stable single-core execution speed combined with moderate memory capacity.
